تستسهلون (form X)
# تَسْتَسْهِلُونَ (tastashilūna) /tas.tas.hi.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَسْهَلَ (istashala)
# تُسْتَسْهَلُونَ (tustashalūna) /tus.tas.ha.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَسْهَلَ (istashala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
